QuestInfo.name: [Lunar New Year Mission] Officer of the Day
QuestInfo.0: Yoria is running a Lunar New Year Video Message Project. She's helping deliver messages between officers and their families while they aid in Maple World's restoration! But who will be Officer of the Day?
QuestInfo.1:
Today's lucky Officer of the Day is Claudine!
You'll find Claudine #bunder the Lunar New Year 
tree#k. Tell her all about the Lunar New Year 
Video Message Project!
QuestInfo.2: Claudine seemed really excited about the event. Talk to her again.

default.0: Claudine is #bunder the Lunar New Year tree#k.
